Memory for: On Desktop with a shared underlay space, if my own space and the shared one both have a page with the same name, which copy do I see?
[1] API/sbShare.md (Configuration)
  sbShare.resolve(uri): Returns the space URL and page name a share URI points to, choosing the longest matching known space (one in `share.silverbullet.spaces` or with a stored credential on this device), or nil. The space’s own URL (with or without a trailing slash) gives the page name `""`: it can be a collection root, but isn’t a page to read or write, and isn’t listed (a collection rooted at a whole space is published member by member, with nothing offered for removal).
  Helpers behind sharing pages to another SilverBullet space. See [[^Library/Std/Infrastructure/SilverBullet Share]] and [[API/share]]. / A shared page is addressed by a URI of the form `<space url>/<page name>`, for example `https://example.com/notes/Shared/Page`. Reads and writes use the other space’s `.fs` API with a token obtained through the device flow, kept under the credential key `sb:<space url>` (see [[API/auth]]). / One `net.readURI:` / `net.writeURI:` service pair handles every space. Its `match` resolves the URI when it is dispatched, so it claims URIs of any space known at that moment (from `share.silverbullet.spaces` or a stored credential), including spaces configured after this page loaded. Its priority is above the generic `https:` reader.
[2] Meta Space.md (How it works)
  #desktop / A Meta Space is one of your [[Local Space|local spaces]] that SilverBullet Desktop underlays into all the others, so its configuration, libraries and templates are available everywhere. / SilverBullet Desktop supports unlimited spaces. That’s great for keeping contexts separate. The downside: anything you want available _everywhere_ — a shared snippet of `CONFIG.md`, a [[Space Lua]] library you wrote once and want to reuse — has to be copied into every space, and kept in sync. Not great. / The **Meta Space** is the way out. It’s a SilverBullet+ feature available with [Desktop Pro](https://silverbullet.md/pricing) that lets you nominate one of your spaces as a shared underlay for all the others. Anything you put in your meta space (config, libraries, custom commands, templates) automatically becomes available in every other space. The dashboard currently labels it a beta feature.
[3] Shared Pages.md (Status)
  The Shared Pages view lists every page in your space that is [[Share|shared]], in four groups: / * **Pages**: pages you push, pull or sync. / * **Collections**: your [[Share/Collection|collections]], each with its number of pages and its target (in a narrow sidebar the target may not fit), and its member pages under it. When a collection’s `pages` function fails, the error is shown under it instead. / * **Libraries**: installed [[Library|libraries]]. / * **Repositories**: installed library repositories. / Open it with ${widgets.commandButton("Navigate: Shared Pages")}. It opens in the right sidebar. From its dock menu you can move it to the left  ...
